faqs.a: We build native Android and iOS apps, cross-platform apps with Flutter and React Native, and apps for wearable technology. We'll recommend the best option for your goals and budget.

faqs.q: Where is your mobile app development company located?
faqs.a: Our development centre is at A100, 2nd Floor, Sector 58, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, serving clients across Delhi NCR, India. We also have a US office at 1964 Gardner Cir E, Aurora, IL 60503.

faqs.q: How experienced is Frantic Infotech?
faqs.a: Frantic Infotech was established in 2016. Our team of 75+ skilled professionals has delivered 1000+ projects with a 95% success rate on time and within budget.

faqs.q: Do you provide end-to-end app development?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide end-to-end services: app prototyping and wireframing, user experience and product design, development, backend systems integration, and quality assurance and testing.

faqs.q: Do you offer support after the app goes live?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer post-development customer support and 24/7 expert help with every project, even after launch, so your app keeps running smoothly.

faqs.q: Do you also offer AI services?
faqs.a: Yes. Along with mobile app development, we provide AI services: AI chatbots and assistants, generative AI features, machine learning, smart recommendations, image recognition and automation.

faqs.q: Which technologies do you use?
faqs.a: We work with Flutter, React Native, React.js, Angular, Node.js, Laravel, CodeIgniter, PHP, FastAPI and Tailwind, with MongoDB, MySQL and MSSQL databases, choosing what fits your project.
